source_identity: Exact source hashes are in validation-source-sha256.txt; validated-source.tar.gz contains the tested Python source and official model header.
coverage: Official seven-feature integer predictor matches C++ over 4100 input vectors with undefined-behavior sanitization.
Research-only integer heads support count and Q12 fraction feature transforms; production header emission refuses research models.
Baseline seven features and all augmented variants use identical known-capture movement rows, role/cohort weights and frozen map-group splits.
Unknown capture histories and planning-only episodes cannot become invented zero-valued contradiction features.
Contract schema, required columns, event/query bounds and future stall labels are checked; old unmeasured telemetry cannot enter augmented comparisons.
Per-game unsampled totals have verified hashes and reject duplicate field/epoch rows; overlapping episode histories are not presented as actual event rates.
Planning reachability and failed-movement outcomes remain separate from the direction-cost benefit target.
Grouped split expansion, immutable cohort provenance, policy-role balancing, distributed gzip/input receipts, partial/failing campaign accounting and legacy baseline fitting are covered.

independent_coverage_finding.problem: Filtering unknown captures could remove an entire format before split validation, and formats with zero complete episode rows could disappear entirely.
independent_coverage_finding.fix: Expected formats come from manifests and loaded rows. Reports include manifest games/maps, observed and eligible maps/episodes, unknown captures and planning-only counts. Fewer than four eligible maps in any expected format fails before writing the split registry.
independent_coverage_finding.regression_test: test_comparison_cannot_drop_an_unsupported_or_zero_episode_format covers both all-unknown and manifest-only formats.

cpp_source_review.result: Approved v2 source; no edits by reviewer.
findings: Original checkTile and directionByGradient signatures restored; named classified/observed entry points share template<bool Track> implementations.
Compile-time false paths eliminate evidence handling; original predicate order, WATER_ONLY first check, selector scan/scoring/ties, strict fallback and RNG operations are preserved.
Owner natural-ground field scope and once-per-category evidence accumulation are maintained.
Capture snapshots follow preparation capture ticks and actual publication; unknown/restored captures remain explicitly unknown; episode features are copied before future labels.
cpp_source_review.caveat: Source review establishes correctness reasoning. Optimized code generation, disabled release performance and actual new-engine gameplay parity are separate parent-owned validation gates.

limitations: No production coefficients were changed or promoted.
These are tooling checks and source review, not a claim of improved gameplay, CPU usage or an augmented C++ runtime model.
No Windows/browser execution or gameplay/save compatibility tests were performed by this reviewer.
Repeated holdout comparisons still require fresh prospective game validation before policy promotion.
